exposure: obstetricians' and trainees' practices regarding counseling for IUCD placement at cesarean section
obstetricians' and trainees' practices regarding insertion of IUCD during cesarean section
outcome: rate of counseling for IUCD placement at cesarean section
rate of IUCD insertion during cesarean operations
cohort: The participants were obstetricians and trainees attending the 49th Annual Scientific Conference of the Society of Gynecology and Obstetrics of Nigeria.
finding: The study found that the practice of counseling and insertion of IUCD at cesarean section is very low among Nigerian obstetricians.
mod_finding: The study found that the practice of intraoperative IUCD insertion during cesarean sections is very low among Nigerian obstetricians.
